node.title: L1 balanced-pencil anchor determinant atlas
node.closure: exact interpolation-module determinant identity and root-matroid basis packing
node.statement: For one exact anchor in a balanced interpolation-module split pencil, the coefficient determinant Delta_0=A_0B-B_0A is an affine coordinate on the complete monic coefficient body. A Bezout-dual vector gives W(P-P_0)=gamma Delta_0L_0 and W=Delta_0J mod W_0 with gcd(J,W_0)=1. If Delta_0J=Q_Delta W_0+R_Delta, the complete exact shell is exactly the primitive split graph W_Delta=W_0+R_Delta, W_Delta|Omega, gcd(Delta_0,1-Q_Delta)=1. Every common-complement owner is one gcd stratum of this family. At deficiency j and fixed owner, the neighbor locators lie in projective dimension at most j+1 and obey both the root-matroid ceiling |C_D|<=floor(C(m,r)/(w+j-r+2)) and the rank-free local Johnson ceiling |C_D|<=floor(C(m,j+1)/C(w+1+j,j+1)). The j=0 stratum is the one-parameter moving-root pencil. A row-sharp count or typed Q transport remains open.
node.notes: EXACT L1/BC BRIDGE 2026-07-29. This pays fixed common-complement charts and removes coefficient multiplicity, but supplies no global owner coalescence, finite-row reserve fit, or L1 promotion.
